header: The frame around a contact form
subheader: Heading, response time, what to write and the button that opens the form.
lead: The TYPO3 form framework handles the form itself. This element shows the band, never the fields, validation or submission.
bodytext:
Use the text to list what visitors should have ready before they write. It cuts down on follow-up questions.

The second action is a ghost button, not a link, because a phone number is a real alternative to the form.
note: Only promise a response time your team can actually meet.
